name: Kimi ni Negai o
source:
It was the beginning of July.
I returned home from school to the countryside, where someone was waiting for me with a smile on his face...

"Hey, long time no see."

It was my childhood friend and hero, Hi-chan.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/9559]Freem[/url]]
translation:
那是7月初。
我回到乡下的家，那里有个人正面带笑容地等着我……

“嗨，好久不见。”

那是我儿时的朋友，也是我心中的英雄Hi-chan。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/9559]Freem[/url]]
